Ca2+ binding affinity is not length dependent per se but is dependent on the extent of cross-bridge attachment in a length-dependent manner.

length-dependent changes in the number and/or affinity of cross-bridge attachments can account for the length dependence of cardiac troponic Ca2+ sensitivity.
